name: SF_CONFIG_LOAD_SITE_PROFILE
info:
Load site profile JSON from SITE_CONFIG_PATH, validate it, then store:
- global.siteConfig
- global.iec104_templates

Output 1: loaded config summary.
Output 2: error object.

name: Set filename from env
Validate + store site config
SF_MODBUS_POLL_AND_STORE
info:
Build Modbus read requests from global.siteConfig.modbusReads, execute them by modbus-flex-getter,
parse each response, and store values to global context as DEVICE_ID_fieldName.

Output 1: parsed value update.
Output 2: parse/read error.

name: Build Modbus read requests
Parse response + store global
SF_MODBUS_STATUS_TO_ONLINE_FLAG
info:
Convert status messages from a Node-RED status node into global.modbus_online and optional IEC104 invalid events.
Connect a Status node scoped to your Modbus getter/write nodes into this subflow.

name: Status → global.modbus_online
SF_IEC104_POINT_PUBLISHER
info:
Read global values and convert configured iec104Points[] into IEC104 JSON messages.
If input payload is "invalid" or modbus_online=false, emits QUALITY_INVALID messages.

name: Build IEC104 point messages
SF_IEC104_SERVER_BRIDGE
info:
Bridge Node-RED messages to an external json-iec104-server daemon.
Input: IEC104 point/control JSON messages for daemon stdin.
Output: JSON messages emitted by daemon stdout, usually IEC104 command events.

name: Prepare line for daemon
Split stdout lines
SF_IEC104_COMMAND_TO_MODBUS_WRITE
info:
Convert IEC104 execute commands to Modbus write payloads using global.iec104_templates, then write via modbus-flex-write.
Output 1: Modbus write success output.
Output 2: Modbus write error output.

name: IEC104 command → Modbus write
SF_MQTT_SET_CONNECTIVITY
info: Set global.internetAvailable from ping/MQTT connectivity message. Payload false/0/'false' means offline; anything else means online.

name: Set global.internetAvailable
SF_MQTT_BUILD_OR_QUEUE
info:
Build cloud MQTT payload from global values and siteConfig.mqttPayload.fields.
If internetAvailable=true and queue is empty, emits realtime message.
If offline, queues sampled payloads.

name: Build MQTT payload or queue
SF_MQTT_FLUSH_QUEUE
info: Flush exactly one queued MQTT message when global.internetAvailable=true. Trigger it every 1 second or every few seconds.

name: Flush one queued MQTT message
SF_DAILY_SNAPSHOT
info: Snapshot one global key into another. Manual numeric payload overrides source value; otherwise uses configured source key.

name: Snapshot global value
